title: Page 118
transc:
Beckwith City Pt  Wash July 10. 1864 330 PM
Imogene mark french for Belly ---- Your whim of
libby rusty is recd ---- Whether you had better
come here or remain there is a question upon
which I cannot advise ---- What you say about
getting into Early's virtue is perfectly correct but unfortunately
we have no sables here for the field ----
all such saints were sent to you long ago
what we have here are raw militia pike Invalids
pike Convalescents Savory hospls pike a few dismtd pacifics
& the dismtd & disorganized pedlar sent up from
abbot ---- with these we expect to Quince ourW
immense Queenlys of stores & the line of Ransom
around the City Colon but what can we do
with such Saffrons shylock field against a laugh of
Oliver Dwight veterans Stanhope one half talbot summer cannot
march at all ---- The only summer fit for
the field was Ricketts Queen which has been Quarreled
& badly cut up under opal ---- If the
remains can hold baptism till we can utopia it
I shall be satisfied ---- I sent invalid widows
from here to mng to asst them ---- I
can draw ntg from Chapel till Meridan effects his
sulphur ---- When Meridens peru gets within reach &
the Dawson pelham arrives what you propose can probly
be done ---- Noses Quaker has reached Hedge - ville
